notes: οἱ Ἱεροσολυμῖται splits with the pronominal *they* on the article and the periphrastic *of Jerusalem* on the gentilic noun; giving the whole phrase to the noun and emptying the article remains defensible, and the unit's note records the reading taken.
*out* rides inside ἐξεπορεύετο's unit under rule 106, πρός having its own English word *unto* and nothing standing to answer to the particle.
